name: Jackass
description: Join sadomasochistic superheroes Johnny Knoxville, Bam Margera, and the rest of the Jackass crew as they terrorize your TV screens and everyone that gets in their way (especially themselves) with their own sick and twisted interpretation of physical entertainment.  Their brand of pranks, goofball antics, and unabashed brutal comedy are sure to bring new meaning to the phrase "Don't Try This At Home!"

videos.title: Gumball 3000 Rally Special
videos.overview: Johnny Knoxville, Chris Pontius and Steve-O join the Gumball 3000 Rally, racing from London to Russia and back with some of the most expensive cars in the world.

videos.title: Backyard BBQ Special
videos.overview: Cameras follow the Jackass crew around as they screened their first movie with a few friends. Razors start shaving heads at the backyard preview.

videos.title: Where Are They Now
videos.overview: The Jackass crew talk about how they met and what they've been doing now that the show is over.

videos.title: MTV 24 Hour Takeover
videos.overview: Beginning at noon ET on Saturday, February 23, Johnny Knoxville, Bam Margera, Wee Man, Chris Pontius, Steve-O, Dave England, Preston Lacy, and Ehren McGhehey "run" MTV for 24 hours, broadcasting their favorite stunts, taking questions, performing new skits and stunts along with other banter and pranks.

videos.title: Shark Week 2.0
videos.overview: Johnny Knoxville, Chris Pontius, Wee Man, Jasper, Dark Shark, Zach Holmes and Poopies are back! After Knoxville sent the guys on a terrifying Shark Week mission last year, Knoxville joins the boys as they head out to get Poopies over his fear of sharks.

videos.title: Presents Mat Hoffman's Tribute to Evel Knievel
videos.overview: Jackass Presents: Mat Hoffman's Tribute to Evel Knievel is a 2008 direct-to-DVD comedy film and the first Jackass Presents film in the Jackass franchise. It was released on May 27, 2008. The film is a tribute to the stuntman Evel Knievel, who died on November 30, 2007, one year before the film's release.

videos.title: A Tribute to Ryan Dunn
videos.overview: A special to celebrate and honor the life of the late Ryan. The tribute will give viewers an intimate look into Ryan's life, from his early years in Ohio, to his antics with the Jackass crew, to his untimely death in June of 2011. The special will showcase his charm, charisma and genuine spirit that touched the lives of so many, through accounts by his family and closest friends, including Johnny Knoxville, Rob Dyrdek, Wee Man, Chris Pontius, Jeff Tremaine, Bam Margera and many more.

videos.title: The Making of Jackass The Movie
videos.overview: This TV special aired two months before the actual Jackass The Movie came onto the big screen.   The Jackass cast tells us about the making of the movie and you get a good look behind the scenes of all the action that went on while making the film.

videos.title: 2.5: The Extras
videos.overview:
When director Jeff Tremaine and the members of Jackass were out shooting footage for their last theatrical endeavor, Jackass 2, they would up with so much material that they essentially had enough for two movies. The best of that material wound up in the theatrical film while the leftovers have been assembled here on this DVD and released as Jackass 2.5. So, going in knowing that this is the stuff that didn't make the final cut, is it worth watching?

"If you dig Jackass, yeah, it is."

videos.title: The Making Of Jackass 3D
videos.overview: The franchise that most of the Western world knows as Jackass—a crew of loveable, Teflon-coated miscreants consisting of Chris Pontius, Bam Margera, Wee Man, Steve-O, and Johnny Knoxville—began years ago when the group decided to document their gleefully destructive antics on camera. What this VBS Special highlights is that the crew behind the Jackass cameras—director Jeff Tremaine, cinematographers Rick Kosick and Dimitry Elyashkevich, and writer Preston Lacy—have also been with the show since its humble, hand-held beginnings, and embraced the new mode of filmmaking and the new crew that came with it. Join VBS as we go behind the scenes on the set of the third Jackass film, Jackass 3D, and see what happens when the time-tested tradition of unhygienic pranksterism and unbridled camaraderie meet the technological wonders of three-dimensional film.

videos.title: 3.5: Extras: European Tour
videos.overview: The boys travelling around Europe performing goofball stunts and promoting the new movie.

videos.title: 3.5: Extras: The Beginning
videos.overview: Jackass: The Beginning is a DVD extra on Jackass 3.5 that documents how Big Brother Magazine developed into the Jackass crew.

videos.title: 3.5: Extras: Outtakes
videos.overview: Jackass 3.5 was a home media version with additional footage. The film was compiled from outtakes shot during the making of the third film and released in weekly installments on Joost from April 1 through June 13, 2011. The first trailer was originally released online on January 27, 2011, and the feature-length movie was released on Blu-ray and DVD on June 14, 2011, less than a week before Ryan Dunn's death.
